evidence.notes: When fixed search results are absent, SOSL scans local org records in deterministic object and insertion order.
Search.query returns local org-backed SOSL result groups for supported RETURNING clauses.
Search.find returns SearchResults DTOs from deterministic local org matches.
Search.suggest returns local suggestion DTOs from name-like fields and respects the local limit option.
USER_MODE and SYSTEM_MODE route through the local permission checks for supported search rows.
Search.find is the generated docs member for the local SOSL result DTO path.
Search.find accepts an Object-cast AccessLevel and routes through the same local SOSL model.
Search.query accepts an Object-cast AccessLevel and routes through the same local SOSL model.
Test.setFixedSearchResults accepts exact Id values and deterministically controls the local SOSL result set.

name: query-runtime-local-search-sosl-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 clean-org rejects the exercised local Search overloads; retained as local query evidence and excluded from hosted parity.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeLocalSearchSOSLEvidenceTest { @isTest static void localSearchOverloadsUseFixedRows() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Nook Supply'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{account.Id}); List<List<SObject>> rows = Search.query('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)'); System.assertEquals(1, rows[0].size()); Search.SearchResults results = Search.find('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)'); System.assertEquals(1, results.get('Account').size()); Search.SuggestionOption option = new Search.SuggestionOption(); Search.SuggestionResults suggestions = Search.suggest('Noo', 'Account', option); System.assertEquals(1, suggestions.getSuggestionResults().size()); List<List<SObject>> accessRows = Search.query('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, accessRows[0].size()); List<List<SObject>> objectRows = Search.query('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)', (Object)AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, objectRows[0].size()); Search.SearchResults objectFound = Search.find('FIND {Nook*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)', (Object)AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, objectFound.get('Account').size()); Search.SuggestionResults objectSuggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Account', (Object)new Search.SuggestionOption()); System.assertEquals(1, objectSuggestions.getSuggestionResults().size()); Search.SuggestionResults objectUserSuggestions = Search.suggest('Nook', 'Account', (Object)new Search.SuggestionOption(), (Object)AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(false, objectUserSuggestions.hasMoreResults()); } }
